# Gramlot examples 0.2.2

First release of the example pages as a package: PyPI `gramlot-examples`
(module `gramlot_examples`) and npm `@gramlot/gramlot-examples`.

## Contents

- The common example pages in three families: `html_svg` (`e01`–`e13`),
  `binding` (`b01`–`b11`) and `controllers` (`c01`–`c09`). Each registry carries
  the pages of its language, with their README, same-name stylesheet and logic
  companion (`NN_name_aux.js`).
- The gallery page (`gallery/page.py`, `gallery/page.js`), its stylesheet and its
  browser bundle, already built (`gallery/dist/`).
- `catalog.json`: the common families, without `environment`.
- `build_gallery(catalogs=())` (Python) and `buildGallery({catalogs})` (JavaScript):
  the families, the routes (page, stylesheet, logic) and the static assets (URL,
  file, media type) of the common gallery plus the catalogues of an environment.
  The functions write and serve nothing; each environment serves the gallery with
  its own host.

## Keys

The common families keep the keys `e`, `b` and `c`. An environment catalogue declares
`environment` and names its examples `<environment>-NN`, for example `django-01` or
`bun-01`. A duplicate key or a key outside the rule is an error.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.2 or later.
- Node.js 22 or later, or Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.2 or later.

The theme and the logo come from the installed core package.
